# Initiative

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Stats](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Initiative)*

Initiative determines the order of turns during combat. The combat rules in "Playing the Game" explain how to roll Initiative.

Sometimes a DM might have combatants use their Initiative scores instead of rolling Initiative. Your Initiative score equals 10 plus your Dexterity modifier. If you have [Advantage](../../D20-Tests/Advantage.md) on Initiative rolls, increase your Initiative score by 5. If you have [Disadvantage](../../D20-Tests/Disadvantage.md) on those rolls, decrease that score by 5. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[Combat](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#Combat)").
